sarah.pm: planning note: external pentest next Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC. need decision on KMS access pattern and RBAC snapshot scope.

dmitri.r: recommend synthetic-key approach for any decrypt tests. no real-key access. will provision synthetic KMS key bound to readroom bucket. TTL 3h.

noah.oncall: I'll own the runbook and revocation. will add CloudTrail filter for kms:Decrypt + s3:PutObject, export snapshot post-window.

lea.audit: require RBAC CSV 24h prior and SIEM bookmark for the window. retention for exported snapshot = 30d.

pt-bot: PEN-TEST: Assessor "cerulean" scheduled 2026-08-04T09:00Z. handshake key uploaded.

sarah.pm: owners: provisioning=dmitri.r; runbook/noah.oncall; triage=lea.audit. retest slots: vendor asked for 2 slots, prefer Fri afternoons.

dmitri.r: will post policy snippet in runbook and synthetic key ARN once created.

noah.oncall: dry-run tonight 19:00 UTC to validate pipeline. join if you touch KMS or logging.

sarah.pm: thanks all. reminder: no customer data in readroom, any sample must be synthetic and legal-signed. tag #incidents if scope gets changed.
